machine: Apple M5 laptop on MPS, time guards off
note: The official harness on the four samples on an Apple M5 laptop with PARIVISION_TIME_SHARE, PARIVISION_TOTAL_LIMIT and PARIVISION_RISK_SHARE lifted, so nothing is thinned. On a Colab T4 the detectors take 0.34x and 0.19x of real time; decoding 4K 10-bit on its 2 vCPUs is the bottleneck (see the README).
